selection_dev.population: Fresh MNLI training-population source groups; distinct from standard validation_matched

selection_holdout.population: Fresh MNLI training-population source groups; distinct from standard validation_matched
selection_holdout.purpose: Frozen final capability and candidate-selection regret

candidate_design: Five uniform equal-size 1024-example subsets of fixed original update pool, allowed overlap; membership fixed before outcomes
selection: No labels from selection_dev/holdout may train a predictor or adaptation; only selection_dev may choose a data subset. Holdout is final only.
